note: Axes of the building: x runs 110 m along the long side from the north-west corner towards the north-east one, y runs 66 m across towards the south-west corner. The structural columns stand every 11 m, from x = 11 to 99, in two rows at y = 11 and y = 55. Corners are those of the OSM footprint.

sheets.name: Laboratórios e Auditório
sheets.note: Controls: first and last column of the only row drawn (y = 11). Scale 1:300. The basement is smaller than the building, and the page's scale bar and legend fall inside the building's box, hence the extent.

sheets.name: Caramelo e Museu
sheets.note: Controls: the four corner columns. Scale 1:500. The stair left of the lift is drawn cut by a break line, with its upper steps slightly turned.

sheets.name: Biblioteca e Departamentos
sheets.note: Controls: the four corner columns. The sheet says 1:300 but its scale bar and the column spacing give about 1:368. The extent leaves out the scale bar. The stair right of the lift is drawn cut by a break line and under a label.

sheets.name: Estúdios e Salas de Aula
sheets.note: No columns are drawn as circles here. Controls: the corners of the outer frame, which is 110.26 by 66.25 m, centred on the box. Scale 1:500.
